newsitem.title: USA: Earthquake rocks area north of Bakersfield, Calif..
newsitem.headline: Earthquake rocks area north of Bakersfield, Calif..

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.4 on the Richter scale rocked a remote area northeast of Bakersfield on Tuesday, seismologists said.

A spokeswoman at the California Institute of Technology said the quake struck at 12.12 p.m. (15.12 p.m. EDT) about 13 miles (20 km) south-southeast of Lake Isabella, northeast of Bakersfield, an oil and farming centre.
There were no immediate reports of damage or injuries.
The spokeswoman said the tremor was not an aftershock of any previous earthquake.
Southern California has felt several moderate aftershocks in the past two weeks.
